<noinclude>
Kopfbanner der Eintragskategorien (von den erzeugten Kategorieseiten verwendet).

Parameter: type, title (deutscher Plural), kicker (Zeile über dem Titel, Standard „Verzeichnis“), singular, placeholder, form, table, description, namespace (optional — wo neue Seiten entstehen, z. B. Chronicle), noform=1 (ohne Eingabefeld).
[[Category:Layout templates]]
</noinclude><includeonly><div class="wst-cathead wst-framed wst-accent-{{{type|}}}{{#if:{{{noform|}}}| wst-cathead-noform}}"><div class="wst-seal"><span class="wst-icon wst-icon-{{{type|}}}"></span></div><div class="wst-cathead-body"><div class="wst-cathead-kicker">{{{kicker|Verzeichnis}}}</div><div class="wst-cathead-title">{{{title|{{PAGENAME}}}}}</div><div class="wst-cathead-desc">{{{description|}}}</div><div class="wst-cathead-meta"><span class="wst-cathead-count">{{PAGESINCATEGORY:{{PAGENAME}}|pages|R}} {{PLURAL:{{PAGESINCATEGORY:{{PAGENAME}}|pages|R}}|Eintrag|Einträge}}</span>{{#if:{{{table|}}}|<span>[[Special:Drilldown/{{{table|}}}|Durchstöbern]]</span>}}</div></div>{{#if:{{{noform|}}}||<div class="wst-cathead-actions"><div class="wst-cathead-actions-label">Neuer Eintrag</div>{{#if:{{{namespace|}}}|{{#forminput:form={{{form|}}}|autocomplete on category={{PAGENAME}}|namespace={{{namespace}}}|placeholder={{{placeholder|Name …}}}|button text=Anlegen|no autofocus}}|{{#forminput:form={{{form|}}}|autocomplete on category={{PAGENAME}}|placeholder={{{placeholder|Name …}}}|button text=Anlegen|no autofocus}}}}</div>}}</div></includeonly>
